note: The development engine's rules and weights (doc 24, The development engine; src/audio/music/develop/), tuned by ear in the music lab's Engine tab. candidates: how many pieces are grown per seed; keepBest: how many of the best the seed chooses among. harmony: tensionFollow, how strongly the walk prefers chords whose tension is near the phrase's target (0 ignores it); colorAmount, scales every chord's color chances (0 plain triads and sevenths only, 1 as written in the material); hold, scales the chance a chord lasts another bar; splitLast, the chance a phrase's last-but-one bar holds two chords (the cadence's approach arrives on the bar's later beat); cadenceWeights, multiplies each cadence type wherever a template offers it (1 keeps the material's weights; 0 removes it). score: how the candidates are judged. variety rewards using many different chords; tensionFit punishes distance from the template's curve; repeatWindow punishes a run of four chords that comes back (a loop); stuck punishes the same chord three bars running; colorCrowd punishes more than colorCrowdShare of bars on color chords; bannedLoops are sequences (by place) never allowed, such as I V vi IV.
